extraction: Every page event from one second before each invocation through two seconds after native answer.closed is preserved. Native and extension session events are preserved except repetitive pointer movement and answer chunks/deltas. All page focus/visibility/state-change events and Chrome focus events are retained separately, including setup and later departures.
limitations: Session 1 loses document focus before Close and is not a passing complete session. Trigger unknown; Chrome also records windowId -1.
Session 2 stays focused and visible through Copy, preview display, and answer Close. Standalone preview close is not recorded; answer close cleans up the preview.
No native scroll or resize events were recorded. Window movement is unverified: setup center() generates moved events; preview creation can be labeled answer.moved before previewPanel is assigned.
Copy telemetry records the handler running, not a clipboard read-back or paste verification.
Option/Shift activation remains page-visible. Pointer motion/hover exists without geometry for attribution. No page native-directed clicks, wheel, text input, or DOM mutation in measured sessions.
No broader fullscreen, zoom, multiple-display, keyboard/input-method, or packaged distribution coverage is established.
